verdict.rationale: Fellow's own marketing documents configurable, organization-wide retention policies, including zero-day retention. Its developer docs document deletion of workspace data and notes through the Super Admin API. However, deletion is limited to Enterprise-plan super admins, and the retention controls appear only as homepage claims with no detailed docs. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of retention policy configuration (durations, scope, how deletion is enforced), deletion controls for ordinary users rather than only Enterprise super admins, and independent or hands-on corroboration that retention and deletion work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Set configurable retention policies, including zero-day retention, so data is handled according to your organization’s requirements.
Set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained
Fellow’s Super Admin API lets designated Enterprise‑plan administrators retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace
Only users with super admin privileges can delete notes through the API.
